Weekend forecast: rain, then sun

Showers are expected to move through the region late Friday night, bringing between a quarter and half an inch of rain to most areas before tapering off by Saturday morning.

Skies should clear by Saturday afternoon, with highs in the low sixties and a light breeze from the northwest, making for a pleasant evening across most of the valley.

Sunday looks dry and mild, though forecasters cautioned that another system could arrive early next week, bringing cooler temperatures and the chance of more rain.
